purpose: The deployment topology of a resource as a left-to-right diagram: each column is a depth (domains, project, policy, service, cache rules, integration, storage), each node a collapsible card with the resource kind, its status tag, its name and, when opened, a message and labelled fields; dashed connectors join every node of a column to the next. A node without a name is an unbound slot (dashed, Not bound) and a `bindable` node carries the bind control (bind an existing resource, change it, create one, remove it). Taken from the design sample's workload topology (`TopologyNode`, `TopologyNodeCard`, `TopologyBindNode`, `TopologyBindControl`, the empty node). It reuses `Flow`'s connector engine and anchors and draws its own list semantics, with no node-graph dependency.
useWhen: The topology tab of a project, service or workload: what serves its traffic, in order, and what is still unbound.
A review before a deploy where binding or removing a resource is staged on the diagram.
avoidWhen: A sequence of steps or a pipeline without data cards → use `flow`.
A nested list of items with no flow between them → use `tree`.
related: flow` — the connector engine and anchors this component reuses.
platform/detail/details-page` — the page whose topology tab holds it.
bestPractices: Keep a column per depth and put the nodes that serve in parallel in the same column.
Mark a staged change `dashed` with a warning status and a message that says the deploy applies it.
Mark the last node of each branch `terminal` so no connector leaves it.
Give every unbound slot a message that says what happens without it.
Give a node `href` when its resource has a page: the name becomes a link that ends in the open glyph (`pi pi-external-link`), as every resource name in the console does.

A node that collects many resources and adds to itself, such as Domains (add a domain), puts its `+` in the `actions` slot: an `IconButton` (`pi pi-plus`, `kind="outlined"`, `size="small"`) named `Add domain` inside a `Tooltip`, picked by `node.key`. `bindable` is for a slot that holds one resource (Firewall, Custom Page): it brings its own `+` with the bind menu. Do not hand-draw a node card to get the `+`.
